question: What is the maximum line length for Python course submissions?
answer: The maximum line length for Python course submissions is 99 characters [S1].

citations.title: Python Faq Style Addendum
citations.text:
Course Style Addendum
For course submissions the maximum line length is 99 characters. Docstrings use triple double quotes. Imports go at the top of the file in three groups: standard library, third-party packages, then local modules. Variable and function names use snake_case.
Late policy: a submission loses 10% of its grade for each day it is late, for up to 3 days after the deadline.

S2.title: Python Faq Style Addendum
S2.text:
Frequently Asked Questions
Which Python version does the course use? The course uses Python 3.12 in all examples and tests.
Which editor should I use? Any editor is allowed; VS Code is used in the demonstrations.
Is the statistics module allowed in assignments? Yes. statistics.variance(data) returns the sample variance, while statistics.pvariance(data) returns the population variance. In the same way statistics.stdev is the sample standard deviation and statistics.pstdev is the population standard deviation.
Where do I ask questions? Post them on the course forum; answers are usually given within two working days.
